payload.title: Temperature Scaling over the Holocene
payload.description: This notebook analyzes temperature scaling over the Holocene using spectral analysis techniques. It imports and processes the Temp12k database, performs spectral analysis using the Weighted Wavelet Z-Transform (WWZ) method, and estimates scaling exponents for temperature records. The notebook utilizes the Pyleoclim library for analysis and visualization, producing outputs such as Power Spectral Density (PSD) plots and scaling exponent estimates. The results are visualized through Kernel Density Estimation and spatial mapping.
